title: Doctor Who Franchise Overview
body:
Doctor Who began as a British television series first broadcast by the BBC in 1963, ran in its classic form until 1989, returned as a television film in 1996 and was revived as a series in 2005, with specials, spin-offs and audio dramas documented in public broadcast records.

This public edition records only verifiable facts — series titles, broadcast years, credited creators and formats — in original wording, with no copied scripts or dialogue.

The companion Signature edition is separate, labeled unofficial fiction with original time-travellers and vessels, and it claims no affiliation with or endorsement by the BBC.

How to use this record: start with the overview, then read the work-by-work records in publication order. Every date and credit below is a public fact; no copyrighted text is reproduced anywhere in this database.

title: Doctor Who Reading and Viewing Order Guide
body:
Recommended public order for the works in this database is publication and release order, beginning with Doctor Who (classic series) (1963) and ending with Doctor Who (Series 14, Disney+ era) (2024). That order follows how the franchise actually reached the public, and it avoids assuming any later reordering.

Each title in that list has its own record in this database with its credited creators and format.
